defineDriverControls compares interfaceSel_ to lastResolvedSel_ for userPicked, re-matches only the text before ', ' with the comment that the tail is a live link speed, and setPersistLabel persists by label.
waitBudgetMs computes wireMs*4 and clamps to [20,100], as its comment states.

effectiveGap budgets pacingPeriodUs/5*4 and pacingPeriodUs returns framePeriodUs_ (the 7/8-smoothed render period from tick) when it exceeds 1e6/fps.
runEncodeLoop ticks RoleFilter::Only Driver, tick() calls tickNonDriverChildren on the split, and moonmodule.md#parallelism states 'no per-driver opt-out' and that core 1 runs every driver's tick().

Both classes inherit InternalRamObject with the refill-interrupt comment, and HotGeometry's comment at ParallelLedDriver.h:510 names the peripheral vtable in flash and the cache-off flash save as the reason for caching shift, outPerPin and slotBytes.
LedPeripheral.h:15-22 names the Strategy pattern, the driver's ownership of controls/lifecycle/tick/encode, and that the per-light encode never calls back into the peripheral.
onTreePrepared calls applyState when sourceShape() != preparedShape_, and SourceShape holds the first layer, enabled layer count, mapped, lights, count and channels.

bootRecord bumps powerOns on ESP_RST_POWERON and restarts on abnormal() or a power-on with the young marker set, persist() starts esp_timer one-shots of kQuickPowerOnUs (5 s) and kStableUs (kBootStableMs = 60 s) with the comment about keeping the flash write off the render loop; docs/ has no mention of the boot record.

xtensa.cpp:13-16 and riscv.cpp:11 state the verbatim rule and the hand-grouped crash, xtensa.cpp:37 names the windowed entry/retw ABI, and riscv emitFill ORs the color into li base words at word indices 3-5.
